items.title: Approve the Minutes of the November 19, 2024 Meeting
Community Advisory Committee Report Consent Agenda
Allocate $3,300,000 and Appropriate $350,000 in Prop L Funds, with Conditions, Allocate $672,000 in Prop AA Funds, and Allocate $4,929,000 in Traffic Congestion Mitigation Tax (TNC Tax) Funds
Allocate $2,649,000 and Appropriate $139,890 in Prop L Funds, with Conditions, for Two Requests
Adopt the District 1 Multimodal Transportation Plan Final Report
Approve a Two Year Professional Services Contract with HNTB Corporation in an Amount Not to Exceed $1,103,000 for Technical Services for the San Francisco Freeway Network Management Study
Authorize the Executive Director to Execute a Memorandum of Understanding to Support Implementation of The Portal Project, also known as the Downtown Rail Extension
Award a Construction Contract to Thompson Builders Corporation for the Pier E-2 Parking Lot and Torpedo Building Retrofit Projects
Accept the Audit Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2024
Internal Accounting Report, Investment Report, and Debt Expenditure Report for the Three Months Ending September 30, 2024
